title: Decode: small-op fusion, SP collectives, drafter tail
shape: NVFP4 1-node D3-32 DP-rank slice (L24 view), r24 (384 verify rows), u132k, k=3; ms per decode step
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 baseline (INFRA 18:52 EST, measured/20261118-1900-nvfp4-decode.json); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt at the same slice
gap_analysis: Measured r24 in-step chain (trial4, one KDA+MoE layer = 217 us): the D-FUSE family on the critical path is SpAttnResGather 9.6 us + act_quant(kda_in) 4.0 + act_quant(o_proj) 2.8 + SpReduceAttnRes (ends 10.6 us after the o-proj) + latent rms_norm 2.6 (+ router top-k 4.4, D-MOE); the shared expert's act_quant 2.8 + SiTU-quant 7.1 run on the side stream inside the MegaMoE window (D-MOE measured that overlap costs MegaMoE ~30 us/layer of contention). SOL design for the family: (1) no standalone quantization: every MXFP8 operand is written by its producer (kda_in input by the AG kernel, shared_gu by the RS kernel [done, b435317d85]; o_proj input by KdaWS's o_norm epilogue [D-KDA]; shared down by the SiTU epilogue [D-GEMM]); (2) one fused kernel per layer boundary (done) at the collective floor: AG = multicast of the shard (MXFP8 halves it on KDA layers) + one latency, RS = 4.1 MB unicast push + one latency (NVLS in-switch reduce rejected: same egress bytes plus a flag round); (3) latent RMSNorm into the MegaMoE reduce (D-MOE E2), top-k into the MegaMoE front (D-MOE). Projected family at r24 with (1)-(3): ~0.40-0.45 ms vs achievable 0.37.
inefficiencies: SP boundary collectives at ~1.10-1.17x model after fusion: RS push (4.1 MB/GPU at n=96) runs serially after the o-proj GEMM; a GEMM-epilogue push (D-GEMM) would overlap it (measured: next GEMM PDL-launches ~9 us before each fused kernel ends)
Latent RMSNorm standalone (2.9 us x 92 calls; proposed into the FI MegaMoE combine-reduce, D-MOE)
Router top-k / prepare / SiTU: moved to D-MOE (FI MegaMoE front) / D-GEMM (side-stream MXFP8 shared expert with fused act quant) -- not D-FUSE items any more
Slice drafter is the preview MLA (full-context attention 2.2 ms/step); release GQA drafter tail unmeasured on Rhea
plan: Measure the SP layer-boundary chain (AttnRes pre/post + AG + RS) at n=4/32/96 on 4 GPUs (bench_kimi_k3_sdec_sp_chain.py)
K1: fuse pre-AttnRes + SP all-gather (cluster AttnRes publishing its output rows by multicast, polling the gathered rows)

K2: fuse SP reduce-scatter owner sum + post-AttnRes (cluster AttnRes reading the TP recv slots as its Lamport delta ring, re-arming slots + gather rows); push from the o-proj epilogue (with D-GEMM) or inside K2
Router GEMM + grouped top-k + MegaMoE prepare as one kernel (coordinate with D-GEMM/D-MOE)
SiTU-and-mul (+MXFP8 quant for NVFP4) into the shared gate_up epilogue (with D-GEMM); latent RMSNorm into the combine / latent_up path
Drafter tail: replace the NCCL final AG by the SP multicast gather; fuse tail kernels
